overview.title: Student & Teacher Overview: Lesson 19
overview.text: In this lesson, students develop a deep conceptual and procedural understanding of Translating Graphs of Functions in Module 4: Polynomial and Quadratic Expressions, Equations, and Functions.
outcomes: Students recognize and use parent functions for linear, absolute value, quadratic, square root, and cube root functions to perform vertical and horizontal translations. They identify how the graph of y=f(x) relates to the graphs of y=f(x)+k and y=f(x+k) for any specific values of k, positive or negative, and find the constant value, k, given the parent functions and the translated graphs. Students write the function representing the translated graphs.
overview.teacherInsight: Emphasize precise mathematical definitions and multiple problem-solving representations. Encourage students to check the reasonableness of their numerical solutions.

exitTicket.title: Lesson 19 Exit Ticket: Translating Graphs of Functions
exitTicket.prompt:
Students analyze the graph and critique the reasoning of others. Then, they provide a valid explanation about their argument.

Exit Ticket

Ana sketched the graphs of f(x)=x^{2} and g(x)=x^{2}-6 as shown below. Did she graph both of the functions correctly? Explain how you know.

y=f(x)y=g(x)y=f(x)y=g(x)

Use transformations of the graph of f(x)=\sqrt{x} to sketch the graph of f(x)=\sqrt{x-1}+3.
exitTicket.solution:
MP.3MP.3Ana sketched the graphs of f(x)=x^{2} and g(x)=x^{2}-6 as shown below. Did she graph both of the functions correctly? Explain how you know.

y=f(x)y=g(x)y=f(x)y=g(x)

The function f was graphed correctly, but not g. The graph of g should have been translated 6 units below the graph of f.

Use transformations of the graph of f(x)=\sqrt{x} to sketch the graph of f(x)=\sqrt{x-1}+3.

The graph should depict the graph of the square root function translated 1 unit right and 3 units up.

problems.prompt: Graph the functions in the same coordinate plane. Do not use a graphing calculator.
How would the graph of f(x)=|x| be affected if the function were transformed to f(x)=|x+6|+10?
problems.solution: The graph would be shifted 10 units up and 6 units to the left.

problems.prompt:
Below is a graph of a piecewise function f whose domain is the interval -4≤x≤2. Sketch the graph of the given functions below. Label your graphs correctly.

y=f(x)y=f(x)g(x)=f(x)-1 h(x)=g(x-2) [Be careful; this one might be a challenge.]
problems.solution:
Point out that the graph of h is related to g rather than f. Make sure students recognize that they must find the graph of g first, and then translate it to find h.

y=f(x)y=f(x)y=h(x)y=g(x)y=f(x)y=h(x)y=g(x)y=f(x)

problems.prompt: Study the graphs below. Identify the parent function and the transformations of that function depicted by the second graph. Then, write the formula for the transformed function.
problems.solution:
y=g(x)y=f(x)y=g(x)y=f(x)

The parent function is f(x)=x^{2}, in red. The graph of the transformed function, in black, is the graph of y=f(x) shifted 3 units to the right and 5 units up. The function defined by the translated graph is g(x)=(x-3)^{2}+5.
